item.title: The Creation Narrative Reexamined: What Adam Truly Lost | Moreh Nevuchim Chapters 1-2
item.description:

item.title: Place & Throne: What Makom & Kisei Really Mean | Moreh Nevuchim §1 · Ch 8–9
item.description:
Is HaShem in a place, or on a throne? Moreh Nevuchim I:8 and 9: makom means physical space and, borrowed, status and rank, so Barukh Kevod HaShem MiMekomo speaks of His incomparable standing rather than a location; then the term kisei, throne.

item.title: Does God Sit or Stand? Yashav, Kam & Amad — and Moshe's Endless Prophecy | Moreh Nevuchim I:11-13
item.description:
